I, John Anthony Emmanuel Amarathunga, Minister of Lands,hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the LandAcquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a publicpurpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An allotment of land named as lot "A'' and in extent of about 0.7025Hectare depicted in the Advance Tracing No. KE/GLG/2016/210 dated10.08.2016, prepared by the Surveyor-General, situated in the Villageof Egalkanda in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 65C - Nadeniyain the Kandupita Pattuwa South minor division in the DivisionalSecretary’s Division of Galigamuwa in Kegalle District, inSabaragamuwa Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot A – Pindeniya Watta Boyagoda Kotasa – Extent:0.7025 HectareNorth: Road, canal and Pindeniya Watta Boyagoda Kotasa ; East:Pindeniya Watta Boyagoda Kotasa ; South : Pradeshiya Sabha Road ;West: Pradeshiya Sabha Road and Road.
